name: lift_ablation
description: Comprehensive PhaseForge research evaluation protocol based on literature review & professor feedback. Wave 1: Core Confirmatory Matrix (15 methods) covering 4-way initialization factorial, parameter-matched BC-Large, negative control, generic spherical/Euclidean KMeans controls, linear phase-head init, spherical averaging, PhaseForge-FT, and teacher-forced. Oracle MoE is an evaluation-time routing intervention applied to a fixed trained expert set. Wave 2: Expert scaling (unconfounded K=3/12), jitter sweep (0.0/0.1), and phase label corruption (25%/50%/shuffle).
